about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport SV  P635 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport SV / P635 is the flagship performance variant of the L461 generation Range Rover Sport, launched in 2023. It uses the BMW S68 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 that's part of BMW's hot-vee engine family, sharing its architecture with the S63 and the wider N63 lineage. This is the same engine used in the Range Rover SV and other high-performance BMW and Land Rover models, adapted for the MLA-Flex platform that underpins the latest Range Rover Sport. As with many hot-vee engines, the S68 can exhibit timing chain wear, valve seal wear, coolant system leaks, and bearing wear over time — which we address as standard during every rebuild.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace BMW S68 engines for every Range Rover Sport SV  P635 on the road.

compatibility.intro: The Range Rover Sport SV's BMW S68 is a high-performance hot-vee twin-turbo V8 that requires precise component matching and careful attention to the hot-vee architecture's specific cooling and valvetrain demands. Fitting the wrong components or assuming an older BMW V8 part will work on the S68 risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (BMW S68) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
